title: 英伟达黄仁勋回归引发华尔街热议
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Given the importance of NVIDIA, not just to the US, but the entire chip and technology sector, it would be, I think, a bit remiss for the government just to sit on the sidelines.
segments.zh: 鉴于英伟达不仅对美国、而且对整个芯片和科技行业都至关重要，我认为政府袖手旁观会有些失职。

segments.en: When you need to discipline a CEO, that's an important thing to do, but you don't want to discipline shareholders at the same time. This is just a bad dream. The last two weeks,
segments.zh: 当需要约束CEO时，这很重要，但你不希望同时约束股东。这只是个噩梦。过去两周，

segments.en: we have Jensen back down and it's a buy everything rally. We think markets are going to stay edgy into early next year, that a lot of these big questions people have are not going to be
segments.zh: 黄仁勋回归，市场全面反弹。我们认为市场将保持紧张直至明年初，许多重大问题不会轻易解决。

segments.en: easily resolved. There was a belief that the Chinese were going to be choked out of any kind of technology. And now, of course, this reopens this debate, which is the best approach to handle
segments.zh: 曾有人认为中国会被排除在任何技术之外。现在这重新引发了辩论：处理中国科技公司的最佳方式是什么。
